ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity (white) pixels dominate >90% of the visible surface area against low-intensity (black) pixels localized strictly on the trailing edge and median notch.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white region across both lobes; low-intensity black banding localized to the entire trailing edge boundary and central notch apex.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 75 degrees and significant depth into the fluke center.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular pixel-amplitude peaks and valleys along the entire linear boundary; serrations are most pronounced and textured at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge profile curving outward to sharp, pointed tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two high-contrast, textured clusters of dark and light pixels at the extreme lateral tips (consistent with barnacle colonization); one distinct circular dark focal spot on the inner right lobe near the notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense calcified clusters on the leading and trailing edges of both distal tips; single circular focal scar on the medial-lower quadrant of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Exceptionally high-purity white pigmentation across the ventral surface with minimal secondary mottling.
